structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身就是高度抽象的几何符号（定位针），符合 theme_rules 中 '当 Original 图标本身就是清晰的几何符号...必须保留其主体轮廓' 的条件。因此不需要像游戏图标那样进行语义重构，而是直接对现有的定位针形状进行风格化填充和描边处理。
preserve: 红色的倒水滴形/气球状定位针外轮廓
定位针尖端指向底部的空间关系
内部 'du' 字母的图形化骨架结构
must_preserve: 粗重的黑色/深色手绘风格描边
主题限定色板：砖红/朱红（主体）、奶黄/米白（内部文字）
无渐变、无阴影的平面化质感
recompose_allowed: 将平滑矢量边缘转化为抖动、不规则的手绘边缘
将标准的 'du' 字体转化为粗犷的涂鸦式笔画或几何块面
移除原始图标底部的透视地图路网背景
移除所有高光、环境光遮蔽和立体渲染
restyle: 主体填充改为高饱和度的砖红色纯色块
内部文字改为奶黄色或米白色纯色块
模拟蜡笔或马克笔在粗糙纸面上的涂抹质感
线条粗细不均，转角处处理为圆润或钝角
forbid: 保留原始的白色圆角矩形底板
保留底部的蓝色/绿色透视道路背景
使用细线条或无描边设计
使用非主题色（如原本的浅蓝、浅绿、纯白文字）
保留任何立体光影、渐变效果或写实纹理
改变定位针的基本拓扑结构（如变成圆形或方形）
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle style icon of a Baidu Maps location pin. Centered on a pure black background. The pin is a solid brick-red shape with thick, rough, uneven black marker outlines. Inside the pin, the letters 'du' are abstracted into clumsy, thick brush strokes in creamy yellow or off-white. Flat design, no gradients, no shadows, crayon texture, naive art aesthetic.
color_application: Map original brand red to theme's 'Brick Red/Vermillion'. Map original white text to theme's 'Creamy Yellow/Off-White'. Background forced to Pure Black (#000000). Remove all other colors (blues, greens from map background).
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular black/dark grey hand-drawn outlines around the pin and internal letter shapes. Edges must appear shaky and manual, not vector-smooth.
composition_application: Center the simplified pin icon. Remove the bottom perspective map layer entirely. Ensure the pin occupies 60-70% of the canvas height, floating on the black void.
identity_application: Maintain the iconic teardrop/pin silhouette strictly. Abstract the 'du' text into recognizable but stylized graphic strokes that fit the doodle aesthetic, ensuring it remains legible as the brand mark within the pin.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough hand-drawn outlines
Colors limited to Brick Red, Cream/Yellow, Black
negative_constraints: No realistic map details or road networks
No smooth vector lines or perfect symmetry
No glossy, metallic, or glass materials
No blue or green colors from original map theme
